title: POV: You Did 10 Tiny Things for a Year… Now You Have $5,300 More 😳

lines: One year ago, you didn't make a big resolution. You made ten tiny ones.
scenes.img: {HERO} writing a short list in a small notebook at night, cozy lamp light, vertical composition

lines: Fifty dollars a week, moved to savings automatically. Twenty six hundred by December.
scenes.img: a glass jar filling with coins and bills on a sunny windowsill, vertical composition

lines: Three more dinners at home every week. Over two thousand dollars saved.
scenes.img: {HERO} cooking a colorful pasta dinner in a cozy kitchen, steam rising, vertical composition

lines: A twenty four hour rule for anything over fifty dollars.
scenes.img: {HERO} closing a laptop with an online shopping cart, calm smile, clock on the wall, vertical composition

lines: Jake? See it, buy it. Tags still on.
scenes.img: a young man in a blue shirt opening a closet overflowing with clothes with price tags still attached, vertical composition

lines: Card paid in full every month. Zero interest.
scenes.img: {HERO} pressing a pay full balance button on a laptop, green check mark, vertical composition

lines: New Year's Eve. Five thousand three hundred dollars more. And way less stress.
scenes.img: {HERO} at a New Year's party smiling calmly looking at a savings app, confetti, vertical composition

lines: Want all ten small things? The full story is on my channel.
scenes.img: {HERO} waving at the viewer with a friendly smile, warm living room, vertical composition
